experiment.title: Overlap bounded SSD lookup reads
experiment.implementation: Design template only. No prefetch code or candidate build exists.
experiment.hypothesis: If model-specific lazy-row waits are material, bounded asynchronous page advice may hide part of them.
experiment.only_change: Add macOS handling for already-known lazy lookup rows; preserve shard bytes and mmap/lazy behavior.
prerequisites: Isolated engine manifest and real implementation
proof: Bounds, alignment, shard lifetime, duplicate-row and failure-path checks
Bounded resident pages and outstanding work
Label cold observations separately; no system cache purge
stop_if: No repeatable complete-task gain after two narrow approaches
experiment.limits: System-wide disk reads cannot establish lookup wait. The 96 MiB cap is a proposed bound, not an implemented cache or established optimum.

comparison.adoption_gate: At least 5 percent median complete-task improvement on the chosen workload, or useful capacity gain with an explicitly accepted speed tradeoff; no unexplained quality failure or new swap. Report control drift and all raw passes.
comparison.percentage_rules: TPS gain = 100*(candidate/control-1). Time reduction = 100*(1-candidate/control). Requires finite positive matched metrics. Do not add percentages from separate experiments.
